scenicChapters.title: Slovenia Soca Valley Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through. 63 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it.

places-the-gastaldaga-area-and-the-episc.story: A 281 km round trip from Cividale del Friuli - roughly 4 h 51 in the saddle. It goes by way of Idrija - Old Town, Snežnik-Ždrocle and back through Idrija - Old Town. The highest point is about 900 m. It crosses from Italy into Slovenia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
